{{Quote|Find out if Hallen got his drills from the wreckage, then get that crime lord scumbag to pay up.|Rachel's partner|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Hallen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], but around [[3641 BBY]] managed to hire a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] to deliver to him drills for use in escape. However, [[Rachel's partner|the smuggler]] got shot down over [[Belsavis prison]], leaving a message to his partner [[Rachel]] to try and deliver the drills to Hallen for payment. This never came to pass, as the drills were destroyed by a Republic citizen.
